Cloud Application Tenant Resource Validate Tenant Cred Status
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/casbTenant/validate/status/:tenantId

Retrieves the validation status of the SaaS application tenant based on the tenant ID

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
tenantId
int32
REQUIRED

SaaS application tenant ID

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
tenantId
int32

The SaaS application tenant ID

tenantName
string

The SaaS application tenant name

tenantDeleted
boolean
status
string[]

Status of the scan

Possible values: [CASB_TENANT_ACTIVE, CASB_TENANT_INACTIVE, CASB_TENANT_VALIDATING, CASB_TENANT_VALIDATION_SUCCESS, CASB_TENANT_VALIDATION_FAIL, CASB_TENANT_NORMAL_RETHORIZATION, CASB_TENANT_CONNECTOR_RETHORIZATION]

lastValidationMsg
object
lastTenantValidationTime
int32

Timestamp of when the scan was last validated

tenantAuthorizationInfo
object
